description: Catalog pointer for PLX company skills. Skill ids are authoritative in the skills repo manifest.json (packages[].skillIds).
notes: petralabx/skills is the canonical company skill content repo; pinSha tracks catalog v1.4.0, which grows the plx-engineering-core bundle from 39 to 69 skills (30 added, none removed) by importing the remaining operator-laptop skills, and carries the v1.3.2 hardening: every manifest description is now byte-identical to its SKILL.md frontmatter, enforced by scripts/validate-manifest.py in required CI alongside schema, id/directory parity and gitRef reachability checks. The pinned commit also re-stamps manifest gitRef to the v1.4.0 tree - PLX_MC prefers manifest.gitRef over pinSha, so a stale gitRef would have served the 39-skill v1.3.1 tree despite this pin. legacySourceRepo documents the pre-migration source.
